change.title: pr-5
change.description: adding flexbox to header via mixins (all prefixes)
change.author: awesomerobot

findings.title: Server-rendered header loses right alignment of the panel
findings.body: The server-rendered header (app/views/application/_header.html.erb) is live: it is rendered inside the <noscript> block (app/views/layouts/application.html.erb:40) and by app/views/layouts/no_ember.html.erb:22, which no-Ember controllers use (e.g. app/controllers/users_controller.rb:348). Its markup is .contents > .row > [.title.span13, .panel] (_header.html.erb:3-19). The new flexbox on .contents (header.scss:17-18) only affects .row, the single flex item, so .panel is a block child of a non-flex .row. Removing float:right (header.scss:35-40) leaves margin-left:auto and order(3) with nothing to act on. .title.span13 still floats left (app/assets/stylesheets/vendor/bootstrap.scss:36-39, 46-48), and .login-button floats left (header.scss:42-43), so the login button and nav icons sit beside the logo instead of at the right edge. The Ember header is not affected, because there .panel is a direct flex child (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/header.hbs:2-6). Fix: make .row the flex container in this markup (width: 100%), or keep float:right on .panel for this markup.

findings.title: Small-action buttons move away from the right edge
findings.body: The delete/edit buttons inside .small-action-desc (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/components/small-action.hbs:3-9) have float:right (topic-post.scss:306-310). Before, .small-action-desc was a full-width block inside the 755px .small-action row (app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:730-731), so the float sat at the row's right edge. Now .small-action is a flex row and .small-action-desc is a flex item with auto width, so it shrinks to its text and the float-right buttons sit next to the description. This is a visible layout change that the PR body does not mention. Fix: give .small-action-desc flex-grow (e.g. flex: 1 1 auto) so it fills the remaining width as before. I could not render the page, so this is from reading the CSS.

findings.title: Removed padding breaks the mobile custom-message offset
findings.body: The change removes .small-action-desc's padding-left: 4em (the avatar clearance) and replaces it with padding: 0 1.5% (topic-post.scss:279-280). The mobile stylesheet still applies margin-left: -40px to .custom-message (app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:520-522), which was tuned against that 4em padding. Now the custom message starts about 40px left of the description box, into the avatar column (.topic-avatar is 45px via the i rule at topic-post.scss:267-276). On mobile, a small action with custom message content (small-action.hbs:15-17) would overlap the avatar icon. Fix: restore the left offset for the mobile custom message (for example, put the padding-left back in the mobile rule) or remove the -40px. Not rendered; based on the CSS.

findings.title: Changes beyond the PR description
findings.body: The PR body says only 'adding flexbox to header via mixins'. The diff also changes small-action spacing and padding (topic-post.scss:279-304), removes the 5px margin-top on .extra-info-wrapper .badge-wrapper.bullet (this file, lines 33-35 at head), and adds line-height: 1.5 to .extra-info-wrapper (line 32). Please confirm these are intended and state them in the PR body, and check them on the mobile and no_ember pages.

findings.title: align-items mixin emits a non-existent property
findings.body: -ms-align-items (line 121) is not a CSS property, so the declaration is dead. -webkit-align-items (line 119) only applies to Safari 7-8. Trailing whitespace is on line 120. Consider dropping the invalid declaration and the stray whitespace. The other prefixes in the mixin are valid.

contracts.action: Ember header renders .contents as a flex row (title, extra-info, panel)
contracts.before_after: Before: .title floated left, .panel floated right, .extra-info-wrapper a block with overflow hidden filling the middle. After: flex row with order title 0, extra-info 2 (topic.scss:30), panel 3 (header.scss:37-39) and margin-left:auto on the panel.
contracts.visible_effect: Panel (login, icons, avatar) stays right-aligned. The topic extra info is vertically centred between the logo and the panel.
contracts.failure_mode: A long extra-info title shrinks rather than pushing the panel out, because desktop sets overflow:hidden on .extra-info-wrapper (app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:518-519). On mobile .extra-info is display:none (app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:365-367), so the wrapper is empty there.

contracts.action: Server-rendered header partial renders the panel
contracts.before_after: Before: .panel floated right, so it sat at the right edge. After: .panel is a block inside the non-flex .row, so margin-left:auto and order(3) are inert, and the .login-button float is placed next to the logo.
contracts.visible_effect: On noscript and no_ember pages the login button and icons move from the right edge to beside the logo.
contracts.failure_mode: Layout only. The login and icons stay reachable.

contracts.action: Small action row lays out as flex (avatar and description)
contracts.before_after: Before: block with floated avatar and buttons; .small-action-desc was full width with padding-left 4em. After: flex row; .small-action-desc is a shrink-to-fit flex item with padding 0 1.5%.
contracts.visible_effect: Delete and edit buttons move from the right edge of the 755px row to beside the description text. Text vertical alignment changes (align-items:center).

contracts.action: Mobile custom message inside small action
contracts.before_after: Before: desc padding-left 4em, so the -40px margin on .custom-message stayed inside the desc box. After: no left padding, so the margin takes the message into the avatar column.
contracts.visible_effect: On mobile, custom message text overlaps the avatar icon.

contracts.action: Bullet category badge uses inline-flex with baseline alignment
contracts.before_after: Before: display:inline-flex and align-items:baseline written directly. After: the same via mixins, with the same final declaration order (inline-flex last).
contracts.visible_effect: None. Same computed display and alignment.

contracts.action: extra-info-wrapper gets order 2, line-height 1.5, and loses the bullet margin-top
contracts.before_after: Before: bullet badges in the header had margin-top 5px. After: that margin is removed, and order 2 applies only because the wrapper is a child of the flex .contents.
contracts.visible_effect: Bullet category badge in the header sits 5px higher. Otherwise no change.

contracts.action: New mixins flexbox, inline-flex, align-items, order are called
contracts.before_after: New shared mixins; no existing definitions with the same names (grep of app/assets found only these). align-items emits -ms-align-items, which is not a property.

summary: Reviewed the five stylesheets in this part, plus the templates and layouts that render the selectors they change. The Ember header flex conversion reads correctly. Three layout regressions need fixing: the server-rendered header (used in noscript and no_ember pages) loses right alignment of its panel; the desktop small-action buttons move off the right edge; and on mobile the custom message overlaps the avatar because a -40px margin was tuned to the removed padding. I could not render any page (read-only), so the visual findings rest on the CSS and markup. Two consider-level notes cover undescribed scope in the PR body and a dead vendor declaration in the align-items mixin.
